mapper.select: SELECT ei.item_type FROM explore_items ei LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'EVENT' LEFT JOIN place p ON p.place_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'PLACE' WHERE ei.item_id = #{itemId} AND ei.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND ei.visibility_status = 'VISIBLE' AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( (ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.event_id IS NOT NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'ONGOING')) OR (ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.place_id IS NOT NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.is_active = TRUE) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointments (item_id, host_member_id, language_code, appointment_name, appointment_description, max_members, join_deadline, deposit_amount, appointment_status, meeting_place, meeting_address, meeting_latitude, meeting_longitude, activity_start_at, activity_end_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{hostMemberId}, #{languageCode}, #{appointmentName}, #{appointmentDescription}, #{maxMembers}, #{joinDeadline}, #{depositAmount}, #{appointmentStatus}, #{meetingPlace}, #{meetingAddress}, #{meetingLatitude}, #{meetingLongitude}, #{activityStartAt}, #{activityEndAt})

INSERT INTO appointment_members (appointment_id, member_id, trip_id, membership_status, attendance_status, joined_at, left_at, attendance_confirmed_at) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{memberId}, #{tripId}, #{membershipStatus}, #{attendanceStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{leftAt}, #{attendanceConfirmedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_members SET membership_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE appointment_member_id = #{appointmentMemberId} AND membership_status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE appointments SET appointment_status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE appointment_status = 'RECRUITING' AND join_deadline < #{now} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE appointments SET appointment_status = 'IN_PROGRESS', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE appointment_status = 'CLOSED' AND activity_start_at <= #{now} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE appointment_members SET attendance_status = #{attendanceStatus}, attendance_confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt} WHERE appointment_member_id = #{appointmentMemberId} AND membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND attendance_status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: a.appointment_id, a.item_id, ei.item_type, a.host_member_id, host.display_name AS host_display_name, a.language_code, a.appointment_name, a.appointment_description, a.max_members, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_members count_member WHERE count_member.appointment_id = a.appointment_id AND count_member.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND count_member.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS current_member_count, a.join_deadline, a.deposit_amount, a.appointment_status, a.meeting_place, a.meeting_address, a.meeting_latitude, a.meeting_longitude, a.activity_start_at, a.activity_end_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at

SELECT appointment_member_id, appointment_id, member_id, trip_id, membership_status, attendance_status, joined_at, left_at, attendance_confirmed_at FROM appointment_members WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT am.appointment_member_id, am.appointment_id, am.member_id, am.trip_id, am.membership_status, am.attendance_status, (a.host_member_id = am.member_id) AS host, am.joined_at, am.left_at, am.attendance_confirmed_at FROM appointment_members am JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = am.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE am.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND am.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT appointment_member_id, appointment_id, member_id, trip_id, membership_status, attendance_status, joined_at, left_at, attendance_confirmed_at FROM appointment_members WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND appointment_member_id = #{appointmentMemberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_members SET membership_status = 'LEFT', left_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE appointment_member_id = #{appointmentMemberId} AND membership_status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE appointment_members SET membership_status = 'PENDING', attendance_status = 'PENDING', joined_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, left_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE appointment_member_id = #{appointmentMemberId} AND membership_status = 'LEFT' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT am.appointment_member_id, am.appointment_id, am.member_id, am.trip_id, member.display_name, member.profile_image_url, member.preferred_language, am.membership_status, am.attendance_status, (a.host_member_id = am.member_id) AS host, am.joined_at, am.left_at, am.attendance_confirmed_at FROM appointment_members am JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = am.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN members member ON member.member_id = am.member_id AND member.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE am.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY host DESC, am.joined_at ASC, am.appointment_member_id ASC

SELECT a.appointment_id, a.appointment_name, am.trip_id, a.meeting_place, a.activity_start_at, a.activity_end_at, a.item_id, ei.item_type, a.appointment_status FROM appointment_members am JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = am.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN explore_items ei ON ei.item_id = a.item_id WHERE am.member_id = #{memberId} AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am.trip_id IS NOT NULL AND am.deleted_at IS NULL
AND a.appointment_status != 'CANCELLED'
ORDER BY (a.activity_start_at < NOW()), CASE WHEN a.activity_start_at >= NOW() THEN a.activity_start_at END ASC, a.activity_start_at DESC, a.appointment_id DESC
AND a.appointment_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY a.activity_start_at ASC
